newsitem.title: USA: McWhorter names Stevenson as chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: McWhorter names Stevenson as chairman, CEO.

text.p: McWhorter Technologies Inc said Wednesday it elected John Stevenson as chairman and chief executive officer and Jeffrey Nodland as president and chief operating officer, effective January 1.
It said Stevenson will replace D. George Harris, chairman, who remains as a director. Harris also is chairman and chief executive officer of Harris Chemical Group.
The company also said it named Louise Tonozzi-Frederick as vice president and chief financial officer, effective September 1. She currently is treasurer and controller.
Stevenson has been president and chief executive officer of McWhorter since it was spun off from Valspar Corp in 1994.
Nodland was named executive vice president and chief operating officer of McWhorter in May 1995 and previously was senior vice president and chief financial officer.
